name: GPU Monitor
author: David JM
description: Live view of the graphics card: utilization, clocks, temperatures, power draw, fan speed and VRAM usage. AMD is read straight from the amdgpu sysfs tree; NVIDIA falls back to nvidia-smi. One shared service owns a single helper process that feeds every bar surface.

barWidget.description: A monitor glyph showing GPU utilization and the selected temperature sensor, refreshed every second. AMD is read from the amdgpu sysfs tree with labeled sensors; NVIDIA is read via validated nvidia-smi output and labeled GPU core. Left-click opens a panel with clocks, VRAM, power, fan and per-sensor temperatures. Read-only and unprivileged — no elevation.

schema.label: Hot temperature
schema.description: Turn the readout red when the selected GPU temperature sensor reaches or exceeds this (°C).
